lastCompletedStory.title: Promocao em swap idempotente em vendorCoss

nextStoryContext: vendorCoss now promotes through a unique sibling backup, restores the old destination when staging promotion fails, and removes the backup after success. The idempotence regression test asserts two same-source runs are content-identical and leave only the destination in its parent.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Current existsSync, mkdtempSync, renameSync, and rmSync signatures and synchronous filesystem semantics match the swap implementation.
